headline: Executive order creates a federal committee to review foreign involvement in US telephone, internet, and other telecommunications services.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new federal committee, the Committee for the Assessment of Foreign Participation in the United States Telecommunications Services Sector. Based on its title, the committee's job is to look at foreign participation in American telecommunications services. No official summary was provided, so details about the committee's members, powers, and procedures are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Telecommunications companies with foreign owners or foreign investment
who_it_affects.how: Their involvement in the US telecom services market may be reviewed by the new committee.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in telecommunications and national security
who_it_affects.how: They take part in or work with a formal committee that assesses foreign participation in the telecom sector.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 4, 2020; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
